summaries.en: Llama.cpp is an open-source C/C++ implementation that enables efficient large language model inference on consumer hardware, solving the challenge of running sophisticated AI without expensive cloud infrastructure. It achieves remarkable performance through GGML's quantization techniques and optimized CPU computation, demonstrating how careful memory management can make billion-parameter models accessible. Developers can integrate it into desktop applications, build local AI assistants, or experiment with custom model deployments using its straightforward C/C++ API for real-time text generation tasks.
summaries.zh: Llama.cpp 是一个用 C/C++ 实现的开源项目，专门解决在普通硬件上高效运行大语言模型的难题，让用户无需依赖昂贵的云端计算资源。它通过 GGML 量化技术和优化的 CPU 计算实现高性能推理，展示了如何通过精细的内存管理让数十亿参数模型在本地设备上流畅运行。开发者可以将其集成到桌面应用中，构建本地 AI 助手，或利用其简洁的 C/C++ API 进行自定义模型部署实验，非常适合需要实时文本生成的实际场景。

summaries.en: 12-factor-agents is a set of principles for building production-grade LLM-powered applications, inspired by the 12-factor app methodology. It addresses common pitfalls like context window mismanagement and lack of observability by advocating for explicit state, modular tooling, and robust logging. Developers can apply these patterns to design agents that are scalable, maintainable, and reliable in real-world deployments, making it easier to move from prototype to production.
summaries.zh: 12-factor-agents 是一套构建生产级 LLM 应用的原则，借鉴了 12-factor 应用方法论。它针对上下文窗口管理不当、缺乏可观测性等常见问题，提出显式状态管理、模块化工具设计和健壮日志记录等核心实践。开发者可遵循这些模式，设计出可扩展、易维护且可靠的智能体系统，从而顺利从原型过渡到生产环境。该框架强调工程化思维，帮助团队避免常见陷阱，提升 LLM 应用的稳定性和可调试性。

summaries.en: Academic Research Skills is a prompt-based toolkit that transforms Claude Code into a structured research assistant, guiding users through the full academic pipeline: literature review, writing, peer review, and revision. Its key insight is breaking complex research workflows into modular, repeatable prompts that enforce rigor and consistency. You can use it to draft papers, simulate peer review, or automate literature synthesis—simply load the prompts into Claude Code and follow the step-by-step process.
summaries.zh: Academic Research Skills 是一套提示词工具包，可将 Claude Code 转化为结构化研究助手，引导用户完成文献综述、论文撰写、同行评审及修改定稿等完整学术流程。其核心设计理念是将复杂研究工作流拆解为模块化、可重复的提示词，确保学术严谨性与流程一致性。用户可在 Claude Code 中加载提示词，按步骤进行文献综合、草稿生成或模拟评审，显著提升研究效率。该项目适合需快速产出高质量成果的研究者，也适用于教学场景中演示标准学术流程。

summaries.en: Sana is an efficient text-to-image and video generation model that achieves high-resolution synthesis with a linear diffusion transformer. Its key innovation is replacing quadratic attention with linear attention, drastically reducing computational cost while maintaining quality. Combined with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for alignment and NVFP4 quantization for deployment, Sana enables fast, high-quality generation on consumer GPUs. You can use it for rapid prototyping of visual content, fine-tune it on custom datasets, or deploy it in resource-constrained environments.
summaries.zh: Sana是一个高效的文本到图像及视频生成模型，通过线性扩散Transformer实现高分辨率合成。其核心创新在于用线性注意力机制替代传统的二次注意力，大幅降低计算开销的同时保持生成质量。结合基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）进行对齐优化，并采用NVFP4量化技术便于部署，Sana能在消费级GPU上实现快速、高质量的生成。你可以用它快速原型化视觉内容，在自定义数据集上微调，或部署到资源受限的环境中。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。

summaries.en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.
summaries.zh: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。
